message: NO_TRADE: The complete 18-symbol 14:00 UTC package was valid, FRESH, and MARKET_OPEN. EURUSD, GBPUSD, and AUDUSD closed only marginally beyond resistance after the prior impulse, while EURCAD, GBPCAD, and AUDJPY were already extended by roughly 0.9–1.3 ATR. XAUUSD sharply rejected its breakout. Friday entry quality did not justify chasing or stacking correlated exposure.
